set -eu
MAC=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
OLD=d21400207c121eb3169647978072ee18a99269d1
FINAL=3d3b007c518dc6243bc5317330c025de06b30402
test -r "$KEY"
test "$(git -C "$MAC" branch --show-current)" = agent-work
test "$(git -C "$MAC" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FINAL"
test -z "$(git -C "$MAC" status --porcelain=v1)"
test "$(git -C "$MAC" diff --name-only "$OLD" "$FINAL")" = docs/checkpoints/2026-10-31-macbook-trackpad-zoom-deploy.md
test ! -e /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$PI" bash -s -- "$OLD" "$FINAL" <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
OLD="$1"; FINAL="$2"
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$OLD"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
pid_before="$(pgrep -f '[p]ython[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]].*/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/server\.py([[:space:]]|$)' | head -n1)"
git fetch --no-tags origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$FINAL"
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FINAL"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
pid_after="$(pgrep -f '[p]ython[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]].*/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/server\.py([[:space:]]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$pid_before" && test "$pid_before" = "$pid_after"
printf 'PI_FINAL_PID=%s\n' "$pid_after"
printf 'PI_FINAL_SHA=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'PI_HEALTH='
curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
printf '\n'
printf 'PI_HOME_HTTP='
curl -fsS --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
printf 'PI_MAP_HTTP='
curl -fsS --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map
test -f .dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre/app-before.sqlite
test -f .dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre/frontend/index.html
test ! -e .dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre/frontend-next
make server-status
make tunnel-status
REMOTE
printf 'MAC_FINAL_SHA=%s\n' "$(git -C "$MAC" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'MAC_FINAL_DIRTY=%s\n' "$(git -C "$MAC" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
printf 'PUBLIC_SITE_CHECK='
curl -sS -L --max-time 18 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://photomap.pl/ || echo EXTERNAL_HTTP_UNAVAILABLE
echo PHOTOMAP_FINAL_CHECKPOINT_SYNC_PASS
